**Johnson & Johnson had the higher fiscal 2023 net margin, by about 37.7 percentage points.** These figures are from memory of the filings, not looked up, so treat them as a best estimate.

| Company | Net income | Revenue | Net margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Johnson & Johnson | $35,153M | $85,159M | about 41.28% |
| Pfizer | $2,119M | $59,553M | about 3.56% |

Difference: 41.28% − 3.56% ≈ 37.72 percentage points.

Two choices affect the result:

- **J&J net income** includes the large gain from the Kenvue separation, reported in discontinued operations. On continuing operations alone (about $13,326M), J&J's margin would be about 15.6%, still well above Pfizer's.
- **Pfizer revenue** is the 2023 figure as re-presented in the 2024 10-K ($59,553M). Using the originally reported $58,496M gives a Pfizer margin of about 3.62% and a gap of about 37.66 points.
